maya: Cutting RC candidate: v2026.03.17-rc1. Artifacts pinned -> gcr.io/redwood/release:v2026.03.17-rc1. Quiet window planned 10:00-11:00 UTC. Need ops + QA ack before promote.
kevin: linking release notes and changelog now — https://git.redwood.ai/releases/v2026.03.17-rc1/notes :eyes:
maya: tl;dr: main fixes: token cache bug, batching fallback, small perf tweak to kv-warm. Release notes snippet:
```
- Fix: token-cache eviction race (hotpath)
- Opt: reduce kv-warm CPU by ~12%
- Chore: bumped transform-lib to 2.4.1
```
ashok: DB migration? any schema changes or feature flags to set during promo?
sarah: CI smoke passed for canary (3/3), load test stable at target qps. deploy-bot: CANARY_SMOKE: all checks passed for v2026.03.17-rc1 (canary: us-west-2 x3) :white_check_mark:
maya: no schema migrations. One feature flag: `enable_kv_warm_v2` should be toggled on after promo. We'll leave it off during canary.
jordan: rollback plan? quick commands + where to find artifact if we need to roll back fast.
maya: rollback quicks:
- revert to previous stable tag: `deploybot promote --artifact gcr.io/redwood/release:v2026.02.28-stable --route prod`
- if traffic needs immediate cut, use `ops toggles traffic --route prod --percent 0 --to-route fallback`
Artifacts stored in registry with immutable tags, shard: gcr://redwood/releases/2026/03/17/rc1
kevin: noted. I'll prepare release-note tweet and internal changelog.
ashok: ack for DB/no-migrate. I'll be oncall during promo.
sarah: ops: can we schedule a 15m post-promo telemetry check at 10:20 UTC? I'll run smoke queries.
maya: yes. I'll trigger promote at 10:05 UTC to give us 15m bake within quiet window. If any regressions, roll back per commands above.
kevin: +1
jordan: +1, holding pager.
maya: promoting in 15. tagging this thread for audit: @deploy-bot promote-request v2026.03.17-rc1 -> prod. :rocket:
